'''Tudor Stefan Rațiu''' (born March 18, 1950) is a Romanian-American mathematician who has made contributions to [[geometric mechanics]] and [[dynamical systems theory]].

==Education==
Rațiu was born in [[Timișoara]].<ref name="conf">{{cite web |title=Conferinta: Dr. Tudor RATIU - 12 ianuarie 2017 |trans-title=Conference: Dr. Tudor RATIU - 12 January 2017 |url=http://lascog11.info.uvt.ro/fmi/evenimente/conferinta-dr-tudor-ratiu-12-ianuarie-2016 |website=Facultatea de Matematică şi Informatică |access-date=25 May 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180319004133/http://lascog11.info.uvt.ro/fmi/evenimente/conferinta-dr-tudor-ratiu-12-ianuarie-2016 |archive-date=19 March 2018 |language=Romanian |date=12 January 2017}}</ref> His father, {{ill|Mircea Rațiu|ro|Mircea-Dimitrie Rațiu}}, an engineer, was the younger brother of [[Ion Rațiu]], a well-known Romanian politician, while his mother, Rodica Bucur, was a piano professor at the Conservatory of Music in Timișoara.<ref name="father">{{in lang|ro}} {{cite web|url=https://jurnalul.ro/stiri/observator/a-murit-fratele-lui-ion-ratiu-589177.html|title=Obituary of Ion Raţiu's brother|access-date=2018-03-18|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180319084745/http://m.jurnalul.ro/stiri/observator/a-murit-fratele-lui-ion-ratiu-589177.html|archive-date=2018-03-19|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="genealogy">{{in lang|ro}} {{cite web|url=http://ratiu.org/ratiu-family/|title=Genealogy of Rațiu Family| website=ratiu.org|access-date=2018-03-19}}</ref> Ratiu did his undergraduate studies at the [[Politehnica University of Timișoara]], completing his [[B.Sc.]] in 1973 and his [[M.S.]] in 1974.<ref name="conf"/><ref name="vita">{{cite web|url=http://memocs.univaq.it/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/Ratiu-CV.pdf|title=CV from 2016|access-date=March 18, 2018}}</ref>

After moving to the United States, he completed his [[Ph.D.]] degree at the [[University of California, Berkeley]] in 1980; his dissertation, written under the supervision of [[Jerrold E. Marsden]], was titled ''Euler-Poisson Equations on Lie Algebras''.<ref name="gen">{{MathGenealogy|11699}}</ref>

==Career==
From 1980 to 1983 Ratiu was a T. H. Hildebrandt Research Assistant Professor at the [[University of Michigan]], after which he became an Associate Professor of Mathematics at the [[University of Arizona]]. In 1987 he moved to the [[University of California, Santa Cruz]], where he became a Professor of Mathematics in 1988.<ref name="UCSC">{{cite web|url=https://www.math.ucsc.edu/faculty-research/singleton.php?&singleton=true&cruz_id=tratiu|title=CV at UC Santa Cruz}}</ref>

In 1998 Ratiu moved to the [[École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne]], where he was a professor until 2015.<ref name="vita"/> In 2014–15, he was a Professor of Mathematics at the [[Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology]] in Russia. Since 2016 he is a professor at [[Shanghai Jiao Tong University]] in [[China]].<ref name="vita" /><ref>{{cite web|url=http://math.sjtu.edu.cn/faculty/show.php?id=153|title=Tudor Stefan Ratiu|publisher=Shanghai Jiao Tong University|access-date=February 9, 2020}}</ref>

Ratiu received a [[Sloan Research Fellowship]] in 1980,<ref name="vita"/> and he became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]] in 2012.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list|title=List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society|access-date=2018-03-18}}</ref> In 2003, he was awarded the [[Order of the Star of Romania]], Commander rank.<ref>{{citation|url=https://legislatie.just.ro/Public/DetaliiDocument/44401|title=
Decret nr. 370 din 11 iunie 2003|language=ro|work=[[Monitorul Oficial]]| issue=420|date=June 16, 2003|access-date=May 28, 2025}}</ref>
